meta.primary_construction_note: OTM-side per-contract implied volatility supplies Gamma(K); TRADING-time maturity (375 min/session, 252 sessions/year); chain width +-10 strikes; risk-free rate 6.5%; NO lot-size multiplier applied (see the report).

audit_oi_staleness.verdict: 09:15 open interest tracks the PRIOR session's close and not its own; the measure is ex ante.

realised_minus_implied.definition: realised 5-min session volatility, %, minus the opening ATM implied volatility rescaled to one trading day (iv/sqrt(252)); positive means the session delivered more movement than the option market charged for at the open
